~news: Under arms, nothing moved; no company crossed the border, and no raid reached a neighbor. All settlements held steady at nightfall, with their souls, houses, and coin unchanged from day's toll. Marlstead still has 20 souls and 232 coin, Wellton 12 souls and 184 coin, Hartwick 8 souls and 184 coin, Brookhurst 16 souls and 160 coin, Little Hartmoor 18 souls and 148 coin, Oldstead 21 souls and 136 coin, Ashford 11 souls and 124 coin, Great Milley 12 souls and 112 coin, Ashurst 11 souls and 100 coin, Fernmoor 15 souls and 88 coin. No growth, no loss, no change. Your settlement, if you had one, would face the same calm — balanced, secure, with steady trade and no threat. If you are reading this as a chief without a village yet, know that the peace is real, but it is also a foundation: the longer it holds, the more ready you will be when a company rises, or when neighbors stir.
